job.name: l4r_host_3
job.meaning: фуд-блогерша ~24: светлые волосы в высоком хвосте, зелёный кардиган-поло, тонкая цепочка; фон горчичный; харизматичный фуд-блогер Москвы, фотореализм, однотонный фон палитры «Свежий рынок»; по пояс, ОБА плеча и руки целиком в кадре с запасом по бокам, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки; без надписей
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, of a real-looking, charismatic young Moscow food blogger — a vivid recognisable character, warm and modern, NOT a fashion model, NOT a stock photo. FRAMING (very important): waist-up, the person in the centre, BOTH shoulders and BOTH arms fully inside the frame with generous empty margin (at least 12% of the width) on the left and right, elbows visible, hands relaxed in front at waist level holding nothing; nothing cropped at the sides. Headroom: the top of the head about 14% of the frame height below the upper edge; the face is large and sharp. Expression: lively eyes, but the face NEUTRAL like in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Colours from the attached board «Свежий рынок» (palette only, do NOT copy the man on it): leaf green #23A455, tomato red #FF4B2E, mustard #FFC531, cream #FFF6E9 — clothes and details use these colours. Background: a plain seamless backdrop in ONE palette colour (given below), bright even soft light, natural skin texture. No text, no logos, no brand names, nothing covering the face, no headphones. A young woman of about 24, Slavic features, blonde hair in a high ponytail, a leaf-green knit polo cardigan, a thin gold chain. Backdrop: mustard yellow #FFC531.
